data.evidence_sentence: Applicants who are U.S. citizens, permanent residents, and eligible non-citizens are considered for all merit awards.
data.notes: Page says recipients typically rank in the top 5% of their high school class and that SAT scores are typically above 1500 or ACT above 33, but these are typical profiles, not stated requirements, so min_gpa is empty. The text says the scholarship is renewable for up to four years but gives no renewal conditions. The deadline (December 1 of the current school year) has no year, so it is recorded as annual. The page is a third-party aggregator with empty Amount, Deadline and Awards fields, and the award is a Boston University scholarship, with host country taken from the university name.
